## Overview

This directory contains Enterprise Standards related to data management, information governance, data quality, and information security to ensure consistent data handling across the enterprise.
page_texts.4:
[standards/information/README.md#examples-of-information-standards]

## Examples of Information Standards

- Data modeling and design standards for enterprise data architecture
- Data quality and validation standards with automated quality checks
- Master data management procedures and data stewardship roles
- Data integration and ETL standards for consistent data flows
- Data retention and archival policies for compliance and storage optimization
- Data classification and protection standards for sensitive information
- Metadata management standards for data discovery and lineage
- Business intelligence and reporting standards for consistent analytics
- Data privacy and protection standards for regulatory compliance
- Data governance frameworks and data stewardship processes

[standards/information/README.md#event-driven-data-governance]

### Event-Driven Data Governance

Standards for Kafka topic design, naming conventions, and data governance in event-driven architectures.

| Standard ID | Title | Focus Area | Compliance |
|-------------|-------|------------|------------|
| [STD-INF-EVT-001](event-driven/STD-INF-EVT-001-kafka-topic-design-naming.md) | Kafka Topic Design and Naming | Topic design, naming, data classification | **Mandatory** |

**Key Topics**:
- Topic naming conventions following enterprise standards
- Partition strategy and replication factors
- Data retention policies aligned with compliance requirements
- Schema governance using AWS Glue Schema Registry
- Data classification and security labels (Public, Internal, Confidential, PHI)

**Related Resources**:
- [Application Event Standards](../application/README.md#event-driven-architecture-standards) - Consumer/producer implementation
- [Infrastructure Kafka Management](../infrastructure/kafka-management/) - Platform provisioning and operations
- [Event-Driven Patterns](../../patterns/event-driven/) - Architecture patterns

[standards/information/README.md#domain-scope]

## Domain Scope

The Information domain focuses on:

- **Data Architecture**: Logical and physical data models, data integration patterns
- **Data Governance**: Data quality, master data management, data stewardship
- **Data Security**: Data classification, encryption, access control
- **Data Lifecycle**: Retention, archival, disposal policies
- **Analytics & BI**: Reporting standards, data warehousing, analytics platforms
- **Schema Management**: Schema registry, versioning, compatibility rules

[standards/information/README.md#compliance-and-governance]

## Compliance and Governance

Information standards support compliance with:
- HIPAA (Protected Health Information)
- PCI-DSS (Payment Card Data)
- State privacy regulations (CCPA, etc.)
- Enterprise data governance policies
- Data quality and stewardship requirements
